component.name: Deskstamp
component.summary: Native Desktop Watermark for COSMIC & Wayland

description.p: Deskstamp is a native, ultra-lightweight screen watermark application designed specifically for Pop!_OS COSMIC and modern Wayland desktop environments.

ul.li: Real-time desktop watermark with full mouse and keyboard click-through bypass.
Customizable text, rotation angles, spacing, stroke, and drop shadow.
Zero CPU usage on static backgrounds with native damage tracking.
Persistent overlay during screen recordings (OBS, PipeWire) and presentations.
Native Wayland layer-shell integration without performance bottlenecks.

screenshot.caption: Deskstamp Watermark Settings in Pop!_OS COSMIC

description.p: Initial release with full Wayland Layer Shell support, live settings, and click-through pass-through.
